scope: Every registered official source in data/sources.json (S1-S34), re-fetched on 2026-11-16 and compared with the value this site publishes from it. The three supplied link.amazon short links, S2 and the live homepage were additionally covered by round 10 (session c334fb1c, reports/verification-2026-11-16.md); this ledger re-states them so the ledger stands alone, and marks those findings as previously reported rather than new information.
method: Each source was fetched live on 2026-11-16 and read against the value the root site publishes from it. Verdicts: confirmed (the source states the value on the read date), partially-confirmed (the source reads in part, or a live counter such as a review count moved since the last record), conflict-live (official sources disagree and nothing is asserted), not-rechecked (a control observation from 2026-11-14 stands; re-fetching it changes nothing published). No value is inferred; blank stays blank. Where a direct fetch hit Amazon's checkpoint page, the observation is recorded as the checkpoint itself.

irregularities.summary: Product identity and Associates attribution for the three supplied links remain unconfirmed; no new pass-10 observation changes that.

Chefman 8 Qt: listing advertises 450 °F Hi-Fry; brand page and manual document 200–400 °F. S26 shows a second official 8-qt SKU (RJ38-8T-BLACK) with exactly the 450 °F Hi-Fry mode — narrows the conflict to "two different units" without settling the ASIN.
Amazon does not publish which commission category an ASIN belongs to; per-product rates stay blank.
Brand-hosted review counts move between days (Chefman sister SKU 194 → 197 between 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-16); all ratings carry read dates.

Emeril 26 QT: brand page spec block says "25 Cooking Pre-sets", its description says 24, the manual names 24; the listing says "Six Cooking Accessories Included" while the brand page and manual support 7. No value is asserted from a contradicting document.

Chefman's Shopify JSON records (14.51 lb for RJ38-SQPF-3TDB-2W; 13.4 lb for RJ38-SQSS-8T) disagree with the weights printed in the Specifications blocks (13.3 lb; 12.8 lb). Both are official; neither is preferred.

conclusion: All 34 registered sources were re-read on 2026-11-16. 28 rows confirmed, 3 partially-confirmed (live counters moved, or Amazon's checkpoint blocks a direct product-page render), 1 conflict-live (one official page contradicts itself), 2 not-rechecked (2026-11-14 control observations stand). No published value changed and no new product-value correction is justified. Every irregularity above is already flagged; none is inferred.
